svg.title: Two clusters change while others remain qualified
svg.desc: Emphasize exactly two separately bounded admin-equivalent outcomes and leave other reachable clusters lightly qualified. Reachability and authority must remain different graphical states.

**Frame:** Two cluster boundaries change immediately to `ADMIN-EQUIVALENT`; additional reachable clusters remain lightly outlined and qualified.

**Action:** One credential produces administrator access on two clusters within one second and broader reach elsewhere.

**Caption:**
> ONE LOCAL SECRET OPENS MORE THAN ONE SYSTEM.

**Provenance:** `documented` — `HF-TL`; wording avoids claiming universal administrative control.
